danil.account.title: Danil account
danil.account.description: Sign in with your Danil account. This computer is registered to your account.
danil.account.name_hint: This is how this computer shows in your Danil account. It doesn't change your name in the account.
danil.account.pending_hint: The Danil page opened. If you don't see it, open it again.
danil.account.failed: Could not sign in to Danil.
danil.account.unavailable: The engine in this version of Terminus cannot sign in to Danil yet. Update Terminus.
danil.account.web_description: Your name and photo in Danil. The photo looks the same in Danil, on the web and on every computer.
danil.account.photo_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It changes the photo of your Danil account: it looks the same in Danil, on the web and on every computer.
danil.connect.name_hint: This is how this computer shows in your Danil account. It doesn't change your name in the account.
danil.connect.invalid: This code does not exist or has expired. Go back to Terminus and ask for a new one.
danil.connect.missing_code: The code is missing. Open the link Terminus showed you.
danil.connect.license: Your account has no Terminus license. Ask whoever manages your Danil account for access.
danil.account.offline: Not connected to Danil right now.
danil.error.already_connected: This computer already has a Danil session. Sign out before signing in with another account.
danil.error.radiant_session_required: That workspace no longer has a Radiant session. Sign in with the browser.
danil.error.no_danil_account: That email has no Danil account. Sign in with another account in the browser.
danil.error.ambiguous_danil_account: That email belongs to more than one Danil account. Sign in with the browser to choose.
danil.error.license_required: Your Danil account has no Terminus license.
danil.error.email_not_verified: That email is not verified. Sign in with the browser.
danil.error.invalid_workos_token: That workspace's session expired. Sign in with the browser.
danil.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
danil.error.vault: Could not save the Danil credential on this computer.
danil.error.not_connected: This computer isn't signed in to Danil. Sign in first.
danil.error.image_too_large: The photo is larger than 2 MB. Pick a smaller one.
danil.error.unsupported_image: That photo isn't PNG, JPEG or WebP.
danil.error.unauthorized: Danil no longer accepts this computer's credential. Sign in again.
danil.error.unsupported: Danil's server doesn't offer this yet.
danil.error.unavailable: Danil is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
danil.status.expired_token: The code expired before it was confirmed. Sign in again.
danil.status.access_denied: The connection was declined in the browser.
danil.status.revoked: This computer was removed from your Danil account. Sign in again to reconnect it.
danil.status.revoke_unconfirmed: You were signed out here, but Danil did not confirm it removed the computer. Check your account.
danil.connect.used: This code was already used. If it wasn't you, check the computers in your account.
danil.connect.ambiguous: Your email belongs to more than one Danil account. Write to support and we'll help.
danil.connect.no_account: Your session does not match a Danil account.
danil.connect.denied: Done, it was not connected. You can close this page.
danil.onboarding.title: Sign in with Danil.
danil.onboarding.lede: This computer is registered to your Danil account. Danil opens in your browser and you just confirm.
danil.onboarding.footer: You can do it later in Settings → Danil account.
danil.footer.offline: {who} · not connected to Danil right now
danil.connect.workspace_ask: Connect the workspace {workspace} on {computer} to your account?
danil.connect.workspace_hint: You will see this workspace from the web and your phone with this account. The computer still belongs to whoever registered it.
danil.connect.workspace_done: Done, the workspace is connected to your account. Go back to Terminus.
danil.workspace.title: Danil account of {workspace}
danil.workspace.description: Which Danil account sees this workspace from the web and the phone. Each workspace connects on its own, and it can be a different account from this computer’s.
danil.workspace.unavailable: The engine of this Terminus version cannot connect workspaces to an account yet. Update Terminus.
danil.workspace.sign_in_first: Sign in with your Danil account above to connect this workspace.
danil.workspace.linked_hint: That account sees this workspace from the web and the phone.
danil.workspace.unlinked: This workspace is not connected to any account: it is not seen from the web or the phone.
danil.workspace.pending_hint: The Danil page opened. Whoever signs in there connects this workspace.
danil.error.workspace_not_linked: This workspace is not connected to your Danil account.
